Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

Your detailed cost explanation and stated focus on larger customers suggest that cost recovery and durable business both matter to you. We are prepared to trade a longer contractual commitment for a more competitive price grounded in transparent costs. What room for that exchange can you substantiate by sharing your cost-breakdown XLSX?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our recent orders for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled were at 5.26, 5.84 per 1 (po:4500014292-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). Our current contract passes PPI-C2431 on at 80% weight (ctr:4600070740#3.2), while your quote states it is 38% of your cost; that clause has already raised our price by 11% this year. Other suppliers currently quote this part at about EUR 5.45. We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them. Could you share your cost breakdown for this part, so we can understand the drivers together?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.77 per unit, no index clause, 45 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.76 per unit, no index clause, 30 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.74 per unit, no index clause, 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We acknowledge your volume commitment of 23,700 units per year for 24 months and the recent index movements, which allows us to offer a revised price of €5.40 per unit. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

However, we cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month contract and must include the AS-14404 index clause to account for raw material volatility. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Please note that our internal cost structures remain confidential, and I am fully authorized to negotiate and conclude this agreement with you directly. Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our Angebot contains a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Alternatively, with a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.40 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH team,

You repeatedly stress alloy indexation and explicitly link committed business to better pricing—it sounds like protection from volatility and dependable business are what make a concession possible. We want a competitive base price that recognises the value of both index protection and our commitment. How can you translate that reduced risk into a stronger base-price concession?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,700 units per year for 24 months. Our demand forecast for Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm is up +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 4.86 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 30 days payment, 24 months; EUR 4.84 per unit, AS-14404 index clause (45% share, 0% deadband), 14 days payment, 24 months). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
